title: Vavilov maps where crops were born
summary: Vavilov led worldwide seed-collecting expeditions and identified the centres of origin of cultivated plants.
why: Founded crop-diversity science and the idea of seed banks for food security.

unsung.contribution: Identified the centres of origin of cultivated plants through worldwide seed collection.
unsung.recognition: Persecuted under Stalin, he died in prison in 1943; his reputation was rehabilitated only in the late 1950s.
